title: THE SECRET OF MONKEY ISLAND
subtitle: Lucasfilm Games, 1990 · the EGA demo, on ScummVM 0.6.1's SCUMM engine (v4)
argsHint: -p<dir> where the game is, then its name. Other switches of 0.6.1: -g<scaler> (normal, 2x, 3x, 2xsai, super2xsai, supereagle, advmame2x, advmame3x, hq2x, hq3x, tv2x, dotmatrix), -f for full screen, -m<volume> for the music, -s<volume> for the sound effects, -n for no subtitles.
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the engine paces itself on the SDL clock.

needsData.hint: monkey1-ega-demo/ from monkey1-dos-ega-demo-en.zip, the demo the ScummVM project distributes

controls: a verb at the bottom, then what it acts on
_why: The same ScummVM build as Beneath a Steel Sky, its SCUMM engine (about 68,000 lines of C++) running a v4 game in 16 colours. Held to a native g++ build frame by frame with a scripted player (gate-scummvm).
